messages.author: e6d426c9552b1af9
messages.subject: terminateApp failure in shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

I ran into some problems when I deployed an app to shinyapps.io. The app itself works fine. At one stage I accidentally included too much data in the www folder during deployment. When I realized this I tried to stop the deployment process. This didn't work and caused RStudio to crash. Unfortunately now the app stays running in the previous state (the version before the failed deployed). The app still works, but I can't seem to be able to either stop it or remove it. When I try 

terminateApp("GGPViewer")

I get this message:


Terminating application...
Error: /v1/applications/15980/terminate 409 - Unable to terminate application-15980: 1 tasks in progress.

Any suggestions how I can remove the app?

Storing the app in a different folder with a different name and deploying it works fine. However, if possible I would like to remove the old instance as it clutters my shinyapps account.

Any help is greatly appreciated!

kind regards, Herman
